actual: After runtime activation, GET /api/v1/hmm-evolution/qe-assets/{task}/{loop} returns 503. ManagedQEWorkspaceReadClient calls the QE workspace files collection URL without the canonical trailing slash; the node responds 307 to the slash-suffixed URL, while QEWorkspaceClient treats the redirect as an error. Expected: build the canonical collection URL or safely follow same-origin redirects while preserving authoritative-node routing, bounded reads, and fail-loud errors.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
